fact: The Cairo Economic Court sentenced TikToker Mariam Ayman (Suzy al-Ordoniya) to one year in prison and a EGP 100,000 fine for publishing videos offensive to public morals under the cybercrime law, with the family-values charge dismissed.
title: TikToker Suzy al-Ordoniya handed prison time for 'immoral' content in widely publicized trial
